name: docktor
description: Self-hosting management platform for Docker Compose applications

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "yarn workspace @docktor/server dev" "yarn workspace @docktor/client dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspace @docktor/shared build && yarn workspace @docktor/client build && yarn workspace @docktor/server build
scripts.build:server: yarn workspace @docktor/shared build && yarn workspace @docktor/server build
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env.development -- prisma migrate dev --config=server/prisma/prisma.config.ts && dotenv -e .env.development -- prisma generate --config=server/prisma/prisma.config.ts
scripts.db:push: dotenv -e .env.development -- prisma db push --config=server/prisma/prisma.config.ts && dotenv -e .env.development -- prisma generate --config=server/prisma/prisma.config.ts
